id.description: Category unique identifier generated when the category is created.

parentId.description: Unique identifier of the parent category.

oneOf.description: Category name in the default language.

Map of translations.
The keys should be ISO language codes.
The values should be category names in specified languages.

code.description: Unique category identifier, defined by the user.

oneOf.description: Category description in the default language.

media.description: Media files attached to the category.

id.description: Media file's unique identifier generated when the media file is created.

stored.description: Flag indicating whether the media file is stored in the Category Service.

uploadLink.description: URL where the media file is uploaded, with the file extension specified.

position.description: Position in the category tree (on the same category level).

published.description: Flag indicating whether the category has been published or not.

assignments.description: List of resources assigned to the category.
